user.title: JA-RS485 (Jablotron JA-121T)
user.description:
Connect to the Jablotron JA-121T RS-485 bus interface. Communication runs at 9600 Bd, 8N1.

**Wiring:** the RS-485 side of the JA-121T is galvanically isolated and requires an **external 12 V DC supply** on its +U/GND terminals (it is NOT powered from the Jablotron bus!). Data lines: **A → D+**, **B → D−**, connect GND to the converter's ground. Module mode in F-Link: Terminal.

data_description.port: Serial device of the RS-485 converter, e.g. /dev/serial/by-id/usb-... (recommended) or /dev/ttyUSB0.
data_description.access_code: User code, with prefix if your system uses prefixes (e.g. 1*1234). Use a dedicated code with only the permissions it needs.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the serial port or communication failed.
error.invalid_auth: The control panel rejected the access code (NO_ACCESS).
error.no_response: No response from the JA-121T — check the wiring (A/B lines) and the selected port.
error.unexpected_data: Data received, but it does not match the JA-121T terminal protocol — make sure the module's basic mode is set to Terminal (not U1-A) in F-Link, and check the A/B wires.
error.invalid_code_format: Invalid code format — digits with an optional prefix, e.g. 1*1234.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: Entity filter
init.description:
Choose which sections and PG outputs are created as entities in Home Assistant (e.g. only those your access code has rights to). Empty selection = expose everything the panel reports. Deselected entities are removed from HA.

**Ranges:** every field also accepts ranges — type e.g. `8-20` (or `1-6 8-20 25` at once) and confirm it as a custom value.

**Peripherals (detectors):** position numbers match the Devices tab in F-Link (0 = control panel). Empty selection = detectors appear automatically on their first activation; an explicit selection creates exactly the given positions immediately.
